description: Tags of SQL literals as returned by ACE: for each of 30 literals (integers around the Byte/Integer/Long limits, decimals, exponents, a 29-digit and a 20-digit integer, date, text, Boolean, Null, hex, signed zero), SELECT literal AS V FROM One read (Field Name/Type/Size/Attributes and Value), then SELECT TypeName(literal), VarType(literal) FROM One. Asks the VARIANT tag, exact value, and whether TypeName/VarType exist and agree.
